name: SplitBar

tests.name: telemetry primitives (#1826)

srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `SplitBar` defaults `label`, `a`, `b`, `aLabel`, `bLabel`, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `SplitBar` holds 4 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 4 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization. Written by scripts/reconcile-record-src.cjs --annotate.
whenUse: One horizontal bar splitting a single total into two labelled, colour-coded parts (pass/fail, open/closed) with both counts above it.
whenNot: More than two parts — use a Donut with a Legend.
